Setup Notes
fields.options:
Production domain: https://zivvy.xyz

Create seat-based products in Polar (Zivvy Pro $18/seat/mo, Zivvy Business $30/seat/mo, plus Annual SKUs at 20% off), copy Product IDs here or into env, and register this webhook:

https://zivvy.xyz/api/method/zivvy_brand.billing.webhooks.polar_webhook

Events: subscription.created, subscription.updated, subscription.active, subscription.canceled, subscription.revoked, order.paid.

Optional: Desk → Billing, or bench execute zivvy_brand.billing.setup_polar.setup_polar_products when POLAR_ACCESS_TOKEN is set. Never commit tokens.

Docs: scripts/setup_polar.md and DEPLOY.md in the zivvy_brand app repo.
